title: Commercial Drones Now Outnumber Hobby Drones By 82,301
hook: Commercial drones now outnumber hobby drones by 82,301.
closing: The drone boom became infrastructure, putting more working aircraft above everyday neighborhoods.
question: Would you notice more drones?

segments.say: Commercial registrations reached 453,635, showing drones became working tools rather than mostly expensive toys.
Registered drones reached 837,513, putting a vast new aircraft fleet into shared airspace.
Monthly registrations slowed to 10,500, suggesting the gold rush is maturing into an established industry.
